WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.event_id, e.type, AVG(CASE WHEN b.spent = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE b.spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0) END) AS rate
  FROM budget b
  JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
  GROUP BY e.event_id, e.type
),
t AS (
  SELECT type, AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM ev
  WHERE rate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY type
)
SELECT type, avg_rate, avg_rate / (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) FROM t) AS ratio_to_mean
FROM t
